name: wheelhouse
description: Wheelhouse — static, browser-first Squeekchain holder console. Supported docs-pinned Sepolia v6, unverified read-only v9, unsigned CLI/MCP.

scripts.test: node test/ui.mjs && node test/audit-baseline.mjs && node test/review-regressions.mjs && node test/phase1-safety.mjs
scripts.test:live: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.config.mjs test/live.spec.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.config.mjs test/browser.spec.mjs
